# Operation Types

Part of the **Inventory** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List operation types

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/inventories/operation-types`

Retrieve a paginated list of operation types with filtering and sorting

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: returnOperationType, sourceLocation, destinationLocation, warehouse, company, creator | `warehouse,sourceLocation` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by | `architecto` |
| `filter[name]` | string | No | Filter by name | `Receipt` |
| `filter[type]` | string | No | Filter by operation type values | `incoming` |
| `filter[warehouse_id]` | string | No | Filter by warehouse IDs | `architecto` |
| `filter[company_id]` | string | No | Filter by company IDs | `architecto` |
| `sort` | string | No | Sort field | `-created_at` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/operation-types?include=warehouse%2CsourceLocation&filter%5Bid%5D=architecto&filter%5Bname%5D=Receipt&filter%5Btype%5D=incoming&filter%5Bwarehouse_id%5D=architecto&filter%5Bcompany_id%5D=architecto&sort=-created_at" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]

  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

## Create operation type

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/inventories/operation-types`

Create a new operation type

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `name` | string | Yes | Operation type name. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `type` | string | Yes | Operation type value. |
| `sequence_code` | string | Yes | Sequence prefix. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `print_label` | boolean | No | Generate shipping labels. |
| `warehouse_id` | integer | No | Warehouse ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `reservation_method` | string | No | Reservation method. |
| `auto_show_reception_report` | boolean | No | Auto show reception report. |
| `company_id` | integer | No | Company ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `return_operation_type_id` | integer | No | Return operation type ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `create_backorder` | string | Yes | Backorder policy. |
| `move_type` | string | No | Shipping policy. |
| `use_create_lots` | boolean | No | Allow creating new lots. |
| `use_existing_lots` | boolean | No | Allow selecting existing lots. |
| `source_location_id` | integer | Yes | Source location ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `destination_location_id` | integer | Yes | Destination location ID. Must match an existing stored value. |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/operation-types" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "name": "Receipts",
  "type": "incoming",
  "sequence_code": "IN",
  "print_label": false,
  "warehouse_id": 1,
  "reservation_method": "at_confirm",
  "auto_show_reception_report": false,
  "company_id": 1,
  "return_operation_type_id": 2,
  "create_backorder": "ask",
  "move_type": "direct",
  "use_create_lots": true,
  "use_existing_lots": true,
  "source_location_id": 1,
  "destination_location_id": 2
}'
```

## Delete operation type

<Badge type="tip" text="DELETE" /> `/admin/api/v1/inventories/operation-types/{id}`

Soft delete an operation type

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.

**Path parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | integer | Yes | The operation type ID |




::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X DELETE "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/operation-types/{id}" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/operation-types/{id}", {
  method: "DELETE",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('DELETE', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/operation-types/{id}', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

```python [Python]
import requests

url = "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/operation-types/{id}"

headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}

response = requests.delete(url, headers=headers)

data = response.json()
print(data)
```

:::

**Example response** <Badge type="info" text="200" />

```json
{
  "message": "Operation type deleted successfully."
}
```

::: details Error response — 401

```json
{
  "message": "Unauthenticated."
}
```

:::


---

## Restore operation type

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/inventories/operation-types/{id}/restore`

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.
